findings.evidence: Octonion.lean:409 `theorem self_mul_conj (x : Octonion R) : x * conj x = norm x • 1`; Mathlib `QuadraticMap.polar_self : polar Q x x = 2 * Q x` (Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/QuadraticForm/Basic.lean), so the `y = x` instance of line 468 reads `2 • (x * conj x) = (2 * norm x) • 1`.
findings.fix: Reword to "of which `TauCeti.Octonion.self_mul_conj` is the case `y = x` up to a factor of `2`" (or drop the claim).
findings.issue: Docstring of `mul_conj_add_mul_conj` says `self_mul_conj` "is the case `y = x`". Setting `y = x` gives `2 • (x * conj x) = (2 * norm x) • 1`; `self_mul_conj : x * conj x = norm x • 1` follows only after cancelling `2`, which is unavailable over the arbitrary `CommRing R` this file works over.

findings.evidence: roadmap Suggested.lean:850-856 pins `finrank_derivationAlbert : finrank K (derivationLieAlgebra K (AlbertAlgebra K)) = 52` and `derivationAlbert_equiv_f4`; README.md:623-629 states the target as "Build `AlbertAlgebra K`, prove the Jordan identity, build `derivationLieAlgebra (AlbertAlgebra K)`, prove [52], identify with f₄".
findings.fix: List `finrank_derivationAlbert` and `derivationAlbert_equiv_f4` among the pinned declarations and say they are unproved here too (as the `traceZero` docstring at line 318 already does), rather than calling the Jordan identity the only remainder.
findings.issue: Module docstring claims the Jordan identity is "the one remaining clause of the roadmap target this file otherwise discharges", and the References section (line 86) repeats "The remaining pinned clause `isCommJordan_albertAlgebra` is not proved here". The same roadmap unit also pins `finrank_derivationAlbert` (= 52) and `derivationAlbert_equiv_f4`, neither built here — so more than one clause remains.

summary: Documentation is thorough and mostly accurate, but two claims are wrong: the new octonion lemma's docstring calls `self_mul_conj` its `y = x` case (it is only twice that, which needs cancelling 2), and the Albert module docstring claims the Jordan identity is the sole remaining clause of the roadmap target while the same roadmap unit also pins the `Der H₃(𝕆)` count and the `f₄` identification.
